_comment: Words that should turn up often and have no other way to be learned -- the landforms and their kind,
and the sizes they come in. Their own bucket so a thousand common blocks cannot drown them.
The sizes joined 2026-10-16 (Jonah): colossal and minuscule take fine ink, so a writer who has made
it should already hold them, and large and small were lost among the blocks in the default bucket.
